title: The Observatory
description: A small field guide to everything a conversation can become.
editorial: Original demonstration content, not a historical transcript. Explore the reading tools, then take a short detour into an optional interactive story.

messages.speaker: guide
messages.body:
Welcome to the observatory. Leave a little room for wonder.

A conversation can be **only words**, and still be a whole world. Or it can open a door.

> Maximum capability, minimum intrusion.

messages.speaker: jonathan
messages.body: And occasionally that door needs a good dice roll.

messages.speaker: guide
messages.body:
### A few things in our pockets

- *Emphasis*, **conviction**, and [a useful link](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Observatory).
- A table for keeping our thoughts in order.
- Code, when the words need to be precise.

| Instrument | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Telescope | Look farther |
| Notebook | Look again |

```js
const wonder = questions.length > 0;
```

The expected value of a fair die is $E[X] = \frac{n+1}{2}$.

And a little custom starlight: :spark:

door.body: A brass door stands beneath the telescope. How will you approach?

greeting.body: A warm voice answers. ‘A question is always welcome here.’

locked.body: The lock holds. From inside, someone clears their throat. There is still time for manners.

stars.body:
The dome opens. Above you, the sky has kept every one of its promises.

**End of this small journey.** Try another path whenever you like.
